augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5; raw intensity gamma U(0.8,1.2) and gain U(0.85,1.15)
loss: Foreground Dice+BCE plus 0.5 contact Dice+positive-weighted BCE; focal modulation only when contact_focal_gamma > 0
postprocessing: Astra validation grid; foreground threshold 0.5, min object size 16; see scripts/astra_utils.py
primary_endpoint: Caicedo average object F1 over IoU thresholds 0.50 to 0.90
purpose: Single frozen Astra final study; no test-driven reselection
selection: Best epoch by validation objF1 at contact threshold 0.5; pooled two-seed decoder/TTA grid; rank TTA objF1, then AJI, then PQ
task: Instance segmentation via full-foreground and touching-contact heads
